title: 二一八九 口无遮拦漏老底 意外惊扰神秘人二一八八 马屁拍到马蹄上 铃铛提荡响溪流
content_zh:
“真的？什么真的？”
感觉到身上的力道，壮汉先是一愣，而后猛地倒吸一口凉气：“坏了！
我怎么把这些事情讲出来了？”
咧了咧嘴，壮汉一脸尴尬：“既然被大人听到了那也没有办法，不过晚辈还希望大人能帮我隐瞒一下，因为一些特殊原因，晚辈的事情不能被外人知道。”
红龙王并未理睬对方，表情与眼神都变得复杂无比，心中暗道：难不成…这家伙是被那位派来的？
关于自己的事情，虽然大部分都是事实，可红龙王并未详尽。
在这些年里，在与这片黑影的纠缠中，他已经找到了离开这里的方法，就是让其他人来取代自己。
可惜这么多年过去，红龙王望眼欲穿也等不到第二个人出现，不用想就知道是三毒做了手脚，让此处与外界联系断绝。
留下“勿入”
二字的行为看来矛盾，这却是红龙王故意为之。
虽然已经没了希望，但他还是有着一丝侥幸，希望这里如果真有一天能够来人，对方会凭借此处“善意提醒”
放下对自己的警惕，让他的计划可以得逞！
说到红龙王的计划，其实也没多复杂，他不过是打算将后来人作饵引走之前那些怪物，让他得到机会寻找出路。
可惜计划没有变化快，红龙王知道再等下去只会多生事端，便冒险将壮汉带到了那些怪物的老巢，却没想到这些怪物会倾巢而出，让他得到了可乘之机。
时间紧迫，红龙王只能将壮汉安排在正对门口的位置。
一来对方在这不会影响到自己，二来只要怪物一回来便能第一时间发现对方，为自己争取额外的时间，可谓一举两得！
可他万万没想到这憨里憨气的家伙狗屎运倒是不错，居然抢先“发现”
了出口，消失不见。
担心会错过好不容易送上门的脱身机会，红龙王匆忙跟了下来，却没想到这里会有暗河存在，因此吃了个暗亏，然后就是之前的事情了…
“大人，大人您没事吧？”

见红龙王忽然陷入了沉默，脸色也是红一阵白一阵，壮汉不免有些担心，怀疑对方是不是中了邪。
“老子能有什么事…”
回过神来，红龙王苦涩出声，看向壮汉的眼神复杂无比。
“呃…大人，不如让晚辈过去替你拆了对方的铃铛如何？”
虽然不知道火堆里的那家伙是谁，但壮汉毕竟在织父王和雾阵子那里受训多日，投掷铁索准头十足，说打上眼皮就绝对碰不到下眼皮。
“站住！”
见壮汉就要起身，红龙王低声喝道，“你这家伙也不知道动动脑子，对方藏身在怪物老巢之下这件事暂且不提，就凭他能身坐火中却安然无恙就不简单，先过去看看情况再说。”
“哦…”
见红龙王恢复了正常，壮汉也放心了不少。
之前二人经过之处是那神秘人的侧后方，只能看个大概。
这次二人蹑手蹑脚来到了对方的侧前方，此处刚好可以将对方的一切尽收眼底！
石室之中，篝火跳动，那身形佝偻的神秘人依旧在不停地提荡着手上的铃铛，发出绵延不绝的水声。
确认对方并未发现自己存在，红龙王和壮汉小心翼翼探出头去。
只见火光包裹之中的，是一张皱纹纵横的面孔，对方眼窝身陷，连火光也照不到底。
目光在对方脸上停留片刻，确认自己没有见过这张脸，红龙王又看向了对方的胸口，并未发现半点起伏。
“奇怪，这家伙到底是死人还是活人？”
红龙王十分不解，如果对方是死人，为何还有动作？如果对方是活人，为何没有呼吸？
“嗖…”
就在红龙王如此想着之时，只见壮汉忽然摸起一块石子，就要向那神秘人砸去。
“不要胡来！”

红龙王急忙将对方的动作喝住。
content_en:
"Really? What really?"
Feeling the strength on his body, the strong man was stunned for a moment, and then took a sharp breath: "It's broken!
How did I tell these things? "
Grinning, the strong man looked embarrassed: "Since the adults have heard it, there is nothing I can do about it, but I hope that you can help me hide it. For some special reasons, the junior's affairs cannot be known to outsiders."
The Red Dragon King ignored the other party, his expression and eyes became extremely complicated, and he thought to himself: Could it be that... this guy was sent by that person?
Although most of the things about himself are true, the Red Dragon King did not go into detail.
Over the years, struggling with this shadow, he has found a way out of here, which is to let others take his place.
It's a pity that after so many years, the Red Dragon King couldn't wait for the second person to appear. It didn't take much thinking to know that the three poisons had done something to cut off the place from the outside world.
Leave "Do Not Enter"
The behavior of the two characters seemed contradictory, but this was done deliberately by the Red Dragon King.
Although he has lost all hope, he still has a trace of luck. He hopes that if someone comes here one day, the other party will use this place as a "kind reminder"
Put down your guard against yourself and let his plan succeed!
Speaking of the Red Dragon King's plan, it's actually not that complicated. He just plans to use the people who come after him as bait to lure away the previous monsters, giving him a chance to find a way out.
Unfortunately, the plan did not change quickly. Knowing that waiting any longer would only cause more trouble, the Red Dragon King took the risk and took the strong man to the lair of those monsters, but he did not expect that these monsters would come out in droves, giving him an opportunity.
Time was running out, so the Red Dragon King could only place the strong man facing the door.
Firstly, the other party's presence here will not affect you, and secondly, as soon as the monster comes back, you can find the other party as soon as possible, buying yourself extra time, which can be said to kill two birds with one stone!
But he never expected that this silly guy was so lucky that he "discovered" it first.
exited and disappeared.
Worried that he would miss the opportunity to escape that finally came to his door, the Red Dragon King hurriedly followed him, but he did not expect that there would be an underground river here, so he suffered a secret loss, and then what happened before...
"My lord, sir, are you okay?"
Seeing that the Red Dragon King suddenly fell silent, and his face turned red and white, the strong man couldn't help but feel worried, wondering if the other party was possessed by evil spirits.
"What can happen to me..."
After coming back to his senses, the Red Dragon King made a bitter sound and looked at the strong man with complicated eyes.
"Uh... Sir, how about asking this junior to go over and remove the other party's bell for you?"
Although he didn't know who the guy in the fire was, the strong man had been trained by King Zhifu and Wu Zhenzi for many days, and he was very accurate in throwing iron ropes. He said that if you put the eyelids on, you would never touch the lower eyelids.
"Stop!"
Seeing the strong man about to get up, the Red Dragon King shouted in a low voice, "You guys don't know how to use your brain. Let's not mention the fact that the other party is hiding under the monster's lair. It's not easy just because he can sit in the fire and be safe and sound. Let's go over and take a look at the situation first."
"Oh..."
Seeing that the Red Dragon King returned to normal, the strong man felt relieved.
The place the two passed by before was the side and rear of the mysterious man, so they could only get a rough look.
This time the two of them tiptoed to the side and in front of each other, where they could have a panoramic view of everything about the other party!
In the stone room, the bonfire was beating, and the mysterious man with a stooped figure was still swinging the bell in his hand, making a continuous sound of water.
After confirming that the other party did not notice their presence, the Red Dragon King and the strong man cautiously poked their heads out.
What was seen was a face wrapped in firelight, with wrinkles all over the place. His eye sockets were sunken, and even the firelight couldn't illuminate it.
His eyes stayed on the other person's face for a moment, confirming that he had never seen this face before. The Red Dragon King looked at the other person's chest again and did not notice half of it.Point ups and downs.
"Strange, is this guy dead or alive?"
The Red Dragon King was very puzzled. If the opponent was a dead person, why would he still move? If the other person is a living person, why isn't he breathing?
"Whoosh..."
Just as the Red Dragon King was thinking this, the strong man suddenly picked up a stone and was about to throw it at the mysterious man.
"Don't mess around!"
The Red Dragon King hurriedly stopped the opponent's movements.
